_about: Single source of truth for timing. animation.py (cameras, events, captions, titles) and tools/voiceover.py read this file. Times are seconds from the start of the video at 30 fps.

lines.text: Imagine living in a town where the ground beneath your feet was literally burning.
lines.tts: Imagine living in a town where the ground beneath your feet was literally burning.

lines.text: This is Centralia, Pennsylvania: a coal-mining town of over a thousand people.
lines.tts: This is Centralia, Pennsylvania: a coal-mining town of over a thousand people.

lines.text: In May 1962, a trash fire in an old mine pit most likely spread into a coal seam below.
lines.tts: In May, nineteen sixty-two, a trash fire in an old mine pit most likely spread into a coal seam below.

lines.text: Old mine tunnels fed it oxygen, and it crept beneath the streets.
lines.tts: Old mine tunnels fed it oxygen, and it crept beneath the streets.

lines.text: Crews dug trenches and flushed the mines. Nothing put it out.
lines.tts: Crews dug trenches and flushed the mines. Nothing put it out.

lines.text: Underground, it reached over a thousand degrees. Toxic gas seeped into homes.
lines.tts: Underground, it reached over a thousand degrees. Toxic gas seeped into homes.

lines.text: In 1981, the ground opened beneath a twelve-year-old boy. His cousin pulled him out alive.
lines.tts: In nineteen eighty-one, the ground opened beneath a twelve-year-old boy. His cousin pulled him out alive.

lines.text: Congress set aside 42 million dollars to move the town. Hundreds of homes were torn down.
lines.tts: Congress set aside forty-two million dollars to move the town. Hundreds of homes were torn down.

lines.text: From above, you'd barely know. But the fire has spread beyond the town, and could burn for another century.
lines.tts: From above, you'd barely know. But the fire has spread beyond the town, and could burn for another century.

lines.text: A whole town almost disappeared... and beneath it, the fire kept burning.
lines.tts: A whole town almost disappeared... and beneath it, the fire kept burning.

titles.text: THE TOWN DUMP: AN OLD STRIP-MINE PIT
THE TOWN THAT BURNED FROM WITHIN.
